text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During training, Rulership got a minor 
injury, so we came to the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
You're exaggerating over a little injury 
like this. You worry too much, don't you?
choice_data_list: You can never be too careful.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Well, it's pretty common in games 
for a tiny mistake to come back and 
totally wreck you later.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
However... being too cautious often causes 
one to miss the right opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
This injury isn't enough to force me off 
the board.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: We shouldn't stop; we should move forward.
choice_data_list: No... let's just rest up for today.

Okay, but don't push yourself too hard, 
alright?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: We shouldn't stop; we should move forward.
choice_data_list: No... let's just rest up for today.

Okay, but don't push yourself too hard, 
alright?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Risking making the injury worse by 
continuing training right now is not wise. 
I persuaded her that she should quietly 
step back for now."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Well... I suppose you have a point there.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh. It seems I, too, have lost my 
composure."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"For now, let us follow your strategy. I 
shall do my best to recover quickly."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ha, haha... Looks like this is the end of 
the line for me...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Sigh... Getting injured, misjudging the 
situation... I'm totally hopeless...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because Rulership's injury worsened, I 
hastily called an end to our training 
session.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, no pain... not bad at all. Looks 
like I can keep going like this.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Our judgment was right after all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Rulership trained at a steady, 
comfortable pace.
